search_console.decision: The report covered August 31 through September 27. Its only meaningful position 4-20 page signal was the 510-thread battery page at 21 impressions, zero clicks, and position 7.7; the October 1 release already addressed it. Remaining position 4-20 page rows had only one to four impressions, and one Oklahoma query click was too weak or irrelevant, so no Data-led item was justified today.

authority.action: Published a CDC-, FDA-, and NIH-grounded seizure-care record that separates emergency first aid, prescription cannabidiol, retail CBD, interactions, monitoring, and product claims; added reciprocal links across medication, CBD-label, official-source, grinder, glassware, comparison, and maintenance pages; and logged the Epilepsy Foundation as a qualified factual-review opportunity. No outreach was sent.
